How to Check LIC Policy Status Online 2026: Step-by-Step Guide

2026-06-11T08:00:00.000Z By Hari Kotian

How to Check LIC Policy Status Online in 2026

Keeping track of your LIC policy status is essential -- whether you want to confirm your policy is active, check premium due dates, or verify your surrender value.

Method 1: LIC Customer Portal

1. Visit licindia.in

2. Click 'Customer Portal' under 'Online Services'

3. Register using policy number, date of birth, and mobile number

4. View all policies -- active, lapsed, matured, or paid-up

What you can see:

- Policy status (In Force / Lapsed / Paid-Up / Matured)

- Premium due date and amount

- Sum assured and bonus accrued

- Last premium paid date

Method 2: LIC Digital Mobile App

Download 'LIC Digital' from Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Register with your policy number and date of birth.

Method 3: SMS Service

Send SMS: LICPOL [space] [Your Policy Number] to 56767877

Method 4: Toll-Free Helpline

Call 1800-258-7266 with your policy number ready.

Method 5: Branch Visit

Visit your home branch with identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN) and date of birth.
